{{SupportPage|vendor=Linksys|model=WPC11}} This device is a [[BroMax WE250]] using the [[Intersil ISL37305P]] reference design (probably). The FCC ID appears to be wrong on at least some cards. It is printed as PKW-WPC11-V2.. but no such entry exists.
There are, however, two possible FCC IDs for the device... *PKW-WPC-V2 - filed 06/06/2001 *PKW-WPC11-V29 - filed 11/07/2002, '''Intersil''' ISL37305P reference design [http://djbnetbsd.drivehq.com/PC/NetBSD/PRISM/models.html On djb's PRISM models page] ([http://wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/files/archive/djnetbsd_old/PRISM%20Models.html archived here])
